value.rationale: The integer-modulated triangular B-spline is a canonical compactly supported Gabor generator. An almost-sure frame can still have infinite expected condition number: the exact law shows an \(m=4\) threshold for finite mean, quantitatively distinguishing reliability from mere existence. The exact constant and exponent give sharp quantitative failure risks for any m and are directly motivated by random-periodic sampling.
